name: infer-conventions
title_zh: 翻完整个 Laravel 仓库
tagline_zh: 团队里 Form Request 和裸验证混着写、谁也说不清标准时，它逐文件统计哪种写法占多数。
tagline_en: When half the team uses Form Requests and half validates inline, it counts which style actually dominates, writes.

why_zh: 它读的是代码本身而不是你的 README，所以规则来自实际分布；冲突写法不强行统一。
why_en: It infers from the code, not your README, so rules reflect real distribution; conflicts get flagged as outliers for you to.
